reason: We already get scheduled agent runs from Claude Code and GitHub as part of what we pay for. I would not add another tool and another bill for the same thing.
objection: Pre-alpha and built by one developer. I am not running client repos through that, and the vendor defaults already do most of this.
would_change_my_mind: A clear demo where it reliably ships tested PRs overnight that our vendor scheduling cannot, plus some proof it will still exist in a year.
